definition_zh: 小的；少的；年幼的；微不足道的
definition_en: not large in size or amount, young, or not important
core_image: 一只小小的茶杯放在大托盘上
scene: 她住在一间小公寓里。She lives in a small flat.
sceneCN: 这里 small 是「小的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她住在一间小公寓里。

senses.title: Not large
senses.definition: not large in size
senses.definitionCN: 尺寸不大
senses.example: She lives in a small flat.
senses.why: This is the basic size sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的尺寸义项。

senses.title: Young
senses.definition: young, especially used of children
senses.definitionCN: 年幼的，尤指孩子
senses.example: He has loved boats since he was small.
senses.why: Small size suggests young age.
senses.whyCN: 小尺寸暗示年幼。

senses.title: Little in amount
senses.definition: not much in amount or degree
senses.definitionCN: 数量或程度不大
senses.example: Only a small number of people came.
senses.why: Size extends to quantity.
senses.whyCN: 尺寸延伸到数量。

senses.title: Not important
senses.definition: not important or serious
senses.definitionCN: 不重要或不严重
senses.example: It is only a small problem.
senses.why: Things small in size seem small in weight.
senses.whyCN: 体积小的东西似乎分量也小。

intro.en: Small is an Old English word that first meant slender or narrow.
intro.cn: small 是古英语词，最初意为细长或狭窄。

items.en: Smal meant slender or narrow.
items.cn: smal 意为细的或窄的。

items.en: It widened to mean little.
items.cn: 词义扩展为小的。

items.en: It described importance as well as size.
items.cn: 它既形容尺寸也形容重要性。

items.en: Small talk named light conversation.
items.cn: small talk 指轻松的闲谈。

items.en: Small change named coins.
items.cn: small change 指零钱。

note.en: Small is compared with look-alike words and words for little size.
note.cn: 把 small 与形近词以及表示小尺寸的词作比较。

entries.definition: to show pleasure with the face

normalIntro.en: Small covers size, amount, age, and importance.
normalIntro.cn: small 涵盖尺寸、数量、年龄和重要性。

normal.en: She lives in a small flat.
He has loved boats since he was small.
Only a small number of people came.
It is only a small problem.
They made small talk at the door.
normal.cn: 他们在门口闲聊了几句。

abstract.en: Small things often carry large meanings.
abstract.cn: 小事物常常承载大意义。

abstract.en: A small kindness can change a day.
abstract.cn: 一个小小的善意能改变一整天。

abstract.en: No room is too small for a good idea.
abstract.cn: 再小的房间也容得下好想法。

examples.en: She lives in a small flat.
Only a small number of people came.
It is only a small problem.

dict_mnemonic.text: small 与 smell、smart、smile 形近；small talk 是「闲聊」，small change 是「零钱」。

root: 由古英语 smal（细窄的）演变而来，核心义「尺寸或分量小」。

sensesIntro.en: Small means not large, young, little in amount, or unimportant.
sensesIntro.cn: small 指不大、年幼、数量少，或不重要。

core.en: Little in extent, amount, or weight.
core.cn: 在范围、数量或分量上小。

branches.en: A flat has little floor space.
branches.cn: 公寓的地面空间很小。

branches.en: A child is small in years.
branches.cn: 孩子在年龄上还小。

branches.en: A few people make a small crowd.
branches.cn: 少数人构成小小的人群。

branches.en: A little problem is easy to solve.
branches.cn: 小问题容易解决。

branches.en: Size and importance often travel together.
branches.cn: 尺寸与重要性常常同行。

intro.en: Small builds words for size, scale, and light talk.
intro.cn: small 构成表示尺寸、规模和闲谈的词。

latinIntro.en: Small is a native English word with no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: small 是英语本族词，没有拉丁词根。

items.exampleCN: 我们需要一个更小的盒子。
他们选了一张略小的桌子。

items.example: The smallness of the room surprised me.
It began as a small-scale project.
items.exampleCN: 它起初是个小规模项目。

items.example: We made small talk at the door.
items.exampleCN: 我们在门口闲聊了几句。

definition_zh: 聪明的；智能的；整洁的；刺痛
definition_en: clever, using computers to work by itself, neat and stylish, or to feel a sharp pain
core_image: 一个学生举手抢答，答得又快又准
scene: 她是个聪明的学生，学东西很快。She is a smart student and learns quickly.
sceneCN: 这里 smart 是「聪明的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她是个聪明的学生，学东西很快。

senses.title: Quick to learn
senses.definition: clever and quick to understand or learn
senses.definitionCN: 聪明且理解或学习得快
senses.example: She is a smart student and learns quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 她是个聪明的学生，学东西很快。
senses.why: This is the main modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代主要义项。

senses.title: Working by itself
senses.definition: using computers to perform tasks automatically
senses.definitionCN: 利用计算机自动执行任务
senses.example: The smart lamp turns off at midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 这盏智能灯到午夜会自动关闭。
senses.why: A clever device is called smart.
senses.whyCN: 聪明的设备被称为智能。

senses.title: Neat and stylish
senses.definition: clean, neat, and well dressed
senses.definitionCN: 干净、整齐且穿着得体
senses.example: He looks smart in that dark suit.
senses.exampleCN: 他穿那套深色西装显得很体面。
senses.why: The word also judges appearance.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也用来评价外表。

senses.title: Sting with pain
senses.definition: to feel or cause a sharp stinging pain
senses.definitionCN: 感到或引起尖锐的刺痛
senses.example: His eyes smarted from the smoke.
senses.exampleCN: 他的眼睛被烟熏得刺痛。
senses.why: This is the oldest physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的身体感觉义项。

intro.en: Smart began as a word for stinging pain and grew into a word for cleverness.
intro.cn: smart 起初表示刺痛，后来发展为表示聪明。

items.en: Smeortan meant to sting.
items.cn: smeortan 意为刺痛。

items.en: Smart first meant sharp pain.
items.cn: smart 最初意为尖锐的疼痛。

items.en: It came to mean quick and clever.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示机敏聪明。

items.en: It came to mean neat and stylish.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示整洁时髦。

items.en: Smart now names intelligent devices.
items.cn: smart 现在指智能设备。

note.en: Smart is compared with look-alike words and words for cleverness or style.
note.cn: 把 smart 与形近词以及表示聪明或时髦的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Smart joins quick thinking, neat looks, and the sting of pain.
normalIntro.cn: smart 把机敏、整洁的外表和刺痛联系在一起。

normal.en: She is a smart student and learns quickly.
normal.cn: 她是个聪明的学生，学东西很快。

normal.en: The smart lamp turns off at midnight.
normal.cn: 这盏智能灯到午夜会自动关闭。

normal.en: He looks smart in that dark suit.
normal.cn: 他穿那套深色西装显得很体面。

normal.en: His eyes smarted from the smoke.
normal.cn: 他的眼睛被烟熏得刺痛。

normal.en: That was a smart way to save time.
normal.cn: 那是个节省时间的聪明办法。

abstract.en: Being smart is knowing what not to say.
abstract.cn: 聪明是知道什么不该说。

abstract.en: A smart tool is still only a tool.
abstract.cn: 智能工具终究只是工具。

abstract.en: Old pain can make a person smart in both senses.
abstract.cn: 旧的疼痛能让人在两种意义上都变得 smart。

examples.en: She is a smart student and learns quickly.
examples.cn: 她是个聪明的学生，学东西很快。

examples.en: The smart lamp turns off at midnight.
examples.cn: 这盏智能灯到午夜会自动关闭。

examples.en: His eyes smarted from the smoke.
examples.cn: 他的眼睛被烟熏得刺痛。

dict_mnemonic.text: smart 与 small、start 形近；smart phone 是「智能手机」，look smart 是「显得整洁漂亮」。

root: 由古英语 smeortan（刺痛）演变而来，核心义「尖锐」，后引申为机敏与整洁。

sensesIntro.en: Smart means clever, automatic, neatly stylish, or sharply painful.
sensesIntro.cn: smart 指聪明、自动智能、整洁时髦，或尖锐刺痛。

core.en: A sharp quality of mind, look, or feeling.
core.cn: 思维、外表或感觉上的尖锐特质。

branches.en: A quick mind answers first.
branches.cn: 敏捷的头脑先答出来。

branches.en: A device thinks for itself.
branches.cn: 设备自己作判断。

branches.en: A neat suit sharpens the look.
branches.cn: 整洁的西装让外表更利落。

branches.en: Smoke stings the eyes.
branches.cn: 烟刺痛眼睛。

branches.en: Sharpness links pain and intelligence.
branches.cn: 尖锐把疼痛与智慧连在一起。

intro.en: Smart builds words for cleverness, style, and devices.
intro.cn: smart 构成表示聪明、时髦和设备的词。

latinIntro.en: Smart is a native English word, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: smart 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: She is the smartest in the class.

items.meaning: in a neat or clever way
items.example: He dressed smartly for the interview.
Her smartness showed in every reply.
items.exampleCN: 她的聪明在每个回答中显现。

items.example: He checked the map on his smartphone.
items.exampleCN: 他在智能手机上看地图。
她的智能手表记录步数。

items.example: They smartened the room before guests came.
items.exampleCN: 客人来之前他们把房间收拾整齐。

definition_en: the quality sensed by the nose, to sense it, to give off an odour, or the sense itself
core_image: 新鲜面包出炉，香气飘满厨房
scene: 厨房里飘出新鲜面包的香味。The kitchen smells of fresh bread.
sceneCN: 这里 smell 是「散发气味」（第 3 个义项）；句意：厨房里飘出新鲜面包的香味。

senses.title: Quality sensed by the nose
senses.definition: the quality of something that you notice with your nose
senses.definitionCN: 用鼻子察觉到的某物的特质
senses.example: A sweet smell came from the kitchen.
senses.why: This is the noun sense of odour.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示气味的名词义项。

senses.title: Notice with the nose
senses.definition: to notice something with your nose
senses.definitionCN: 用鼻子察觉到某物
senses.example: I can smell the coffee from here.
senses.exampleCN: 我从这里就能闻到咖啡味。
senses.why: This is the active sensing verb.
senses.whyCN: 这是主动感知的动词义项。

senses.title: Give off an odour
senses.definition: to have a particular quality that can be sensed by the nose
senses.definitionCN: 具有能被鼻子察觉的某种特质
senses.example: The kitchen smells of fresh bread.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房里飘出新鲜面包的香味。
senses.why: The same verb can describe the source.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词也能描述气味来源。

senses.title: The sense itself
senses.definition: the ability to notice odours
senses.definitionCN: 察觉气味的能力
senses.example: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
senses.why: The noun also names the ability.
senses.whyCN: 名词也指这种能力。

intro.en: Smell appears in Middle English, and its deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: smell 出现在中古英语中，更早的来源不确定。

items.en: The word appears in Middle English.
items.cn: 这个词出现在中古英语中。

items.en: Smellen meant to sense an odour.
items.cn: smellen 意为察觉气味。

items.en: It also meant to give off a smell.
items.cn: 它也意为散发气味。

items.en: The noun named the odour.
items.cn: 名词形式指气味。

items.en: Smell also named the sense itself.
items.cn: smell 也指嗅觉本身。

note.en: Smell is compared with look-alike words and words for scent.
note.cn: 把 smell 与形近词以及表示气味的词作比较。

entries.definition: to draw air through the nose

normalIntro.en: Smell is what the nose receives and what the nose does.
normalIntro.cn: smell 既是鼻子接收到的，也是鼻子所做的。

normal.en: A sweet smell came from the kitchen.
I can smell the coffee from here.
normal.cn: 我从这里就能闻到咖啡味。

normal.en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread.
normal.cn: 厨房里飘出新鲜面包的香味。

normal.en: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
The flowers smell wonderful at night.
normal.cn: 这些花在夜里闻起来很香。

abstract.en: Smell remembers what the eyes forget.
abstract.cn: 气味记得眼睛所忘记的。

abstract.en: A familiar smell can open an old room in the mind.
abstract.cn: 熟悉的气味能在心里打开一间旧屋。

abstract.en: Some truths are smelled before they are spoken.
abstract.cn: 有些真相在被说出之前就能被闻到。

examples.en: A sweet smell came from the kitchen.
I can smell the coffee from here.
examples.cn: 我从这里就能闻到咖啡味。

examples.en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread.
examples.cn: 厨房里飘出新鲜面包的香味。

root: 中古英语 smellen 演变而来，来源不确定，核心义「用鼻子察觉气味」。

sensesIntro.en: Smell is an odour, the act of noticing it, giving off an odour, or the sense of smell.
sensesIntro.cn: smell 指气味、闻的动作、散发气味，或嗅觉。

core.en: What the nose can notice or send out.
core.cn: 鼻子能察觉或散发的特质。

branches.en: Bread sends a sweet odour.
branches.cn: 面包散发甜香。

branches.en: A person notices coffee in the air.
branches.cn: 人察觉到空中的咖啡味。

branches.en: A room carries its own scent.
branches.cn: 房间带着自己的气味。

branches.en: A dog's nose is a powerful sense.
branches.cn: 狗的鼻子是强大的感官。

branches.en: The odour and the noticing belong together.
branches.cn: 气味与察觉彼此相属。

intro.en: Smell builds words for odours and the act of sniffing.
intro.cn: smell 构成表示气味和嗅闻动作的词。

latinIntro.en: Smell is a native English word, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: smell 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: There is a strange smell here.

He smelt the rain before it fell.

有味的垃圾桶被清空了。
那里长着一株芳香的花。

items.meaning: a test by smell or a quick check

definition_en: a happy expression with the corners of the mouth turned up, or to make such an expression
core_image: 嘴角上扬的一张温暖笑脸
scene: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。She gave me a warm smile.
sceneCN: 这里 smile 是「微笑」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她对我露出温暖的微笑。

senses.title: A happy expression
senses.definition: an expression of pleasure in which the corners of the mouth turn up
senses.definitionCN: 嘴角上扬、表示愉快的表情
senses.example: She gave me a warm smile.
senses.exampleCN: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。
senses.why: This is the noun sense of the expression.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示表情的名词义项。

senses.title: To make a smile
senses.definition: to make a happy expression with the mouth
senses.definitionCN: 用嘴做出愉快的表情
senses.example: He smiled at the good news.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of acting.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示动作的动词。

senses.title: Show by smiling
senses.definition: to express something by means of a smile
senses.definitionCN: 通过微笑来表达某事
senses.example: She smiled her agreement.
senses.why: A smile can carry a whole message.
senses.whyCN: 一个微笑能承载完整的信息。

intro.en: Smile came into English from a Germanic source.
intro.cn: smile 从日耳曼语来源进入英语。

items.en: Smilen meant to smile.
items.cn: smilen 意为微笑。

items.en: The word entered English as smile.
items.cn: 这个词以 smile 进入英语。

items.en: It named both the act and the look.
items.cn: 它既指动作也指表情。

items.en: A smile became a sign of welcome.
items.cn: 微笑成为欢迎的标志。

items.en: To smile on something can mean to approve.
items.cn: smile on 某事可以表示赞许。

note.en: Smile is compared with look-alike words and words for happy expressions.
note.cn: 把 smile 与形近词以及表示愉快表情的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A smile is a message the mouth can send without words.
normalIntro.cn: 微笑是嘴不用说话就能发出的信息。

normal.en: She gave me a warm smile.
normal.cn: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。

normal.en: He smiled at the good news.
She smiled her agreement.
The child smiled back at the nurse.
He greeted us with a smile.

abstract.en: A smile is the cheapest gift that costs the most to fake.
abstract.cn: 微笑是最便宜的礼物，却最难假装。

abstract.en: Some smiles are doors, and some are walls.
abstract.cn: 有些微笑是门，有些是墙。

abstract.en: The face can speak before the voice begins.
abstract.cn: 在声音开始之前，脸已经说话了。

examples.en: She gave me a warm smile.
examples.cn: 她对我露出温暖的微笑。

examples.en: He smiled at the good news.
She smiled her agreement.

dict_mnemonic.text: smile 与 small、smell、mile 形近；smile at 是「对……微笑」，smile back 是「回以微笑」。

root: 经中古英语来自日耳曼语，核心义「嘴角上扬的愉快表情」。

sensesIntro.en: Smile is a happy expression, the act of making one, or expressing something with it.
sensesIntro.cn: smile 指愉快表情、做出该表情的动作，或借它表达某事。

core.en: Pleasure shown at the corners of the mouth.
core.cn: 在嘴角显露的愉悦。

branches.en: The mouth curves upward.
branches.cn: 嘴角向上弯起。

branches.en: The face answers good news.
branches.cn: 脸对好消息作出回应。

branches.en: Agreement arrives as a smile.
branches.cn: 同意以一个微笑到来。

branches.en: The look and the act are one.
branches.cn: 表情与动作是一体的。

branches.en: A smile can greet and agree at once.
branches.cn: 一个微笑能同时问候并表示同意。

intro.en: Smile builds words for expressions and friendly looks.
intro.cn: smile 构成表示表情和友善神态的词。

latinIntro.en: Smile is Germanic in origin, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: smile 源自日耳曼语，不是拉丁语。

items.example: She smiled at the old photo.
A smiling waiter showed us in.
items.exampleCN: 一位微笑的服务员把我们引进去。

items.example: He ended the message with a smiley face.
items.exampleCN: 他用一个笑脸符号结束了消息。

definition_en: the grey gas that rises from a fire, to breathe in tobacco, to give off smoke, or to cure food with smoke
core_image: 一缕灰烟从烟囱里缓缓升起
scene: 烟从烟囱里升起来。Smoke rose from the chimney.
sceneCN: 这里 smoke 是「烟」（第 1 个义项）；句意：烟从烟囱里升起来。

senses.title: Gas from fire
senses.definition: the grey or black gas produced when something burns
senses.definitionCN: 某物燃烧时产生的灰色或黑色气体
senses.example: Smoke rose from the chimney.
senses.why: This is the basic substance sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本物质义项。

senses.title: Breathe in tobacco
senses.definition: to breathe in smoke from a cigarette, pipe, or cigar
senses.definitionCN: 吸入香烟、烟斗或雪茄的烟
senses.example: He smokes a pipe after dinner.
senses.why: The substance became an activity.
senses.whyCN: 这种物质变成了一种活动。

senses.title: Give off smoke
senses.definition: to produce smoke, often because of heat or a fault
senses.definitionCN: 产生烟，常因受热或故障
senses.example: The old engine began to smoke.
senses.why: The noun became a verb of producing it.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示产生烟的动词。

senses.title: Cure with smoke
senses.definition: to preserve meat or fish by exposing it to smoke
senses.definitionCN: 通过烟熏来保存肉或鱼
senses.example: They smoke fish over the fire.
senses.why: Smoke preserves food as well as carrying heat.
senses.whyCN: 烟既能带热，也能保存食物。

intro.en: Smoke comes from an Old English word of the same meaning.
intro.cn: smoke 来自一个意思相同的古英语词。

items.en: Smoca meant smoke.
items.cn: smoca 意为烟。

items.en: The word kept its meaning.
items.cn: 这个词保留了原义。

items.en: It named the habit of smoking.
items.cn: 它用来指吸烟的习惯。

items.en: Smoke signals carried messages.
items.cn: 烟雾信号传递信息。

items.en: Smoke also means to cure food.

definition_en: a soft covering for the foot, such a covering worn in pairs, or to hit someone hard
core_image: 抽屉里叠好的一双厚棉袜
scene: 他穿了一双厚袜子。He put on a pair of thick socks.
sceneCN: 这里 sock 是「短袜」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他穿了一双厚袜子。

senses.title: Foot covering
senses.definition: a soft cloth covering worn on the foot inside a shoe
senses.definitionCN: 穿在鞋内、套在脚上的软布套
senses.example: He put on a pair of thick socks.
senses.why: This is the basic clothing sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的衣物义项。

senses.title: Socks as a pair
senses.definition: a pair of such coverings worn together
senses.definitionCN: 成双穿着的这种脚套
senses.example: These socks have a hole in the toe.
senses.exampleCN: 这双袜子的脚尖处破了个洞。
senses.why: The plural is the usual way to speak of them.

senses.title: Hit hard
senses.definition: to hit someone or something hard, informally
senses.definitionCN: 非正式地重击某人或某物
senses.example: He socked the ball over the fence.

intro.en: Sock came from Latin soccus, a light shoe.
intro.cn: sock 来自拉丁语 soccus，一种轻便鞋。

items.en: Soccus meant a light slipper or shoe.
items.cn: soccus 意为轻便拖鞋或鞋。

items.en: Socc named a light shoe or slipper.
items.cn: socc 指轻便鞋或拖鞋。

items.en: The word shifted toward a cloth foot covering.
items.cn: 词义转向布制的脚套。

items.en: Sock settled as the everyday word for a short stocking.
items.cn: sock 固定为短袜的日常说法。

items.en: An informal verb socked meant to hit hard.
items.cn: 非正式动词 socked 意为重击。

note.en: Sock is compared with look-alike words and other foot coverings.

a close-fitting covering for the leg
a covering for the foot with a hard sole

normalIntro.en: A sock is the soft layer between a foot and a shoe.
normalIntro.cn: sock 是脚与鞋之间的柔软一层。

normal.en: He put on a pair of thick socks.
These socks have a hole in the toe.
normal.cn: 这双袜子的脚尖处破了个洞。

normal.en: She keeps wool socks in the bottom drawer.
normal.cn: 她把羊毛袜放在最下面的抽屉。

normal.en: He socked the ball over the fence.
One sock is missing from the pair.

abstract.en: Small comforts are rarely noticed until they are missing.
abstract.cn: 小小的舒适很少被注意，直到它消失。

abstract.en: A pair works only when both halves stay together.
abstract.cn: 一双只有两半在一起才有用。

abstract.en: Every ordinary object carries a long history.
abstract.cn: 每件寻常物品都承载着漫长的历史。

examples.en: He put on a pair of thick socks.
These socks have a hole in the toe.
examples.cn: 这双袜子的脚尖处破了个洞。

examples.en: He socked the ball over the fence.

dict_mnemonic.text: sock 与 sack、suck 形近；a pair of socks 是「一双短袜」，knee socks 是「及膝长袜」。

root: 拉丁语 soccus（轻便鞋）经古英语 socc 进入英语，词义由鞋转为短袜。

sensesIntro.en: Sock is a soft foot covering, a pair of them, or an informal verb meaning to hit hard.
sensesIntro.cn: sock 指柔软的脚套、成双的袜子，或非正式地猛击。

core.en: Soft cloth between foot and shoe.
core.cn: 脚与鞋之间的软布。

branches.en: Cloth covers the foot for comfort.
branches.cn: 布料包住脚以求舒适。

branches.en: Two socks are worn and washed together.
branches.cn: 两只袜子一起穿、一起洗。

branches.en: A hand strikes with force.
branches.cn: 一只手用力击打。

branches.en: One item and its pair share the same name.
branches.cn: 单只与成双共用同一个名称。

branches.en: The noun for cloth and the verb for hitting look alike.
branches.cn: 表示布料的名称与表示击打的动词形状相同。

intro.en: Sock builds words for foot coverings and bare feet.
intro.cn: sock 构成表示足部衣物和光脚的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source soccus meant a light shoe.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 soccus 意为轻便鞋。

items.example: One sock fell behind the bed.
The socks are drying by the fire.
He socked the ball into the net.
The children ran sockless on the grass.

items.meaning: a short sock reaching the ankle
items.example: He wears an ankle sock in summer.
Wool socks keep the feet warm.
The school uniform includes knee socks.
The sock drawer is always untidy.

latinEntries.example: Soccus is the Latin source of sock.

definition_zh: 柔软的；温和的；柔和的；软弱的
definition_en: easy to press or bend, gentle, not bright or loud, or not strong enough
core_image: 手掌陷进柔软的枕头里
scene: 婴儿的皮肤很柔软。The baby's skin is soft.
sceneCN: 这里 soft 是「柔软的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：婴儿的皮肤很柔软。

senses.title: Easy to press
senses.definition: easy to press, bend, or shape, not hard
senses.definitionCN: 容易按压、弯曲或塑形，不坚硬的
senses.example: The baby's skin is soft.
senses.why: This is the basic sense of texture.
senses.whyCN: 这是质地的基本义项。

senses.title: Gentle
senses.definition: gentle and not rough or forceful
senses.definitionCN: 温和而不粗鲁、不强硬的
senses.example: She spoke in a soft voice.
senses.why: Texture extends to manner and sound.
senses.whyCN: 质感扩展到举止和声音。

senses.title: Not harsh
senses.definition: not bright, sharp, or strong to the senses
senses.definitionCN: 对感官来说不刺眼、不刺耳、不强烈的
senses.example: The room glowed with soft light.
senses.exampleCN: 房间沐浴在柔和的光里。
senses.why: The word describes light and colour as well as touch.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也形容光和色，而不只是触感。

senses.title: Not strict
senses.definition: not strict or strong enough, sometimes as criticism
senses.definitionCN: 不够严格或不够强硬，有时带批评意味
senses.example: Critics called the policy soft on crime.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者称这项政策对犯罪过于软弱。
senses.why: A lack of hardness becomes a judgment of strength.
senses.whyCN: 缺乏硬度被引申为对力量的评判。

intro.en: Soft is an Old English word for gentle and mild.
intro.cn: soft 是古英语词，意为温和、轻柔。

items.en: Softe meant gentle, mild, or free from hardship.
items.cn: softe 意为温和、轻柔或免受困苦。

items.en: Related Germanic words shared the sense of mildness.
items.cn: 相关的日耳曼语词也有温和的意思。

items.en: The word also came to describe texture.
items.cn: 这个词也开始描述质地。

items.en: It covered voices, light, and colours.
items.cn: 它涵盖声音、光线和颜色。

items.en: It gained a critical sense of being too weak.
items.cn: 它获得了过于软弱的批评性含义。

note.en: Soft is compared with look-alike words and words for gentle or smooth things.
note.cn: 把 soft 与形近词以及表示温和或光滑的词作比较。

entries.definition: to pass flour or sand through a sieve

normalIntro.en: Soft describes what gives way easily, whether cloth, voice, or light.
normalIntro.cn: soft 描述容易让位的东西，无论是布料、声音还是光线。

normal.en: The baby's skin is soft.
She spoke in a soft voice.
The room glowed with soft light.
normal.cn: 房间沐浴在柔和的光里。

normal.en: This pillow is softer than mine.
He has a soft heart for stray animals.
normal.cn: 他对流浪动物心肠很软。

abstract.en: Softness is strength that chooses not to press.
abstract.cn: 柔软是选择不施压的力量。

abstract.en: Gentle things often last longer than hard ones.
abstract.cn: 柔和的东西往往比坚硬的东西更长久。

abstract.en: What yields can also support.
abstract.cn: 会弯曲的东西也能承托。

examples.en: The baby's skin is soft.
She spoke in a soft voice.
The room glowed with soft light.
examples.cn: 房间沐浴在柔和的光里。

dict_mnemonic.text: soft 与 softly、soften 同根；soft voice 是「轻柔的声音」，soft drink 是「软饮料」。

root: 古英语 softe（温和、轻柔），与日耳曼语同源，核心义「容易让位、不坚硬」。

sensesIntro.en: Soft means easy to press, gentle, not harsh, or not strict enough.
sensesIntro.cn: soft 意为容易按压的、温和的、不刺眼的，或不够强硬的。

core.en: Something that gives way under touch.
core.cn: 在触碰下会让位的东西。

branches.en: A hand sinks into a pillow.
branches.cn: 手陷进枕头里。

branches.en: A voice stays low and kind.
branches.cn: 声音保持低沉而友善。

branches.en: Light fills a room without glare.
branches.cn: 光线充满房间却不刺眼。

branches.en: A critic calls a policy too weak.
branches.cn: 批评者称政策过于软弱。

branches.en: Touch and manner share one word of gentleness.
branches.cn: 触感与举止共用一个表示温和的词。

intro.en: Soft builds words for gentleness, texture, and making things less hard.
intro.cn: soft 构成表示温和、质感和使变软的各词。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic in origin and has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词源于日耳曼语，没有拉丁语词根。

items.example: It is the softest bed in the house.
The softness of the cloth surprised me.
items.exampleCN: 这块布的柔软让我惊讶。

items.example: They served soft drinks at lunch.
items.exampleCN: 午餐时他们提供了软饮料。

definition_en: to find the answer to a problem, puzzle, or difficulty
core_image: 一个人把缠成一团的绳子一点点解开
scene: 他们花了一小时才解决那道谜题。They spent an hour trying to solve the puzzle.
sceneCN: 这里 solve 是「解答；破解」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他们花了一小时才解决那道谜题。

senses.title: Fix a problem
senses.definition: to find a way to deal with a problem or difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 找到处理问题或困难的办法
senses.example: The team solved the problem in one meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 团队开了一次会就解决了问题。
senses.why: The Latin root means to loosen, and a problem is a knot.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「松开」，而问题正像一个绳结。

senses.title: Find the answer
senses.definition: to find the correct answer to a puzzle or question
senses.definitionCN: 找出谜题或问题的正确答案
senses.example: They spent an hour trying to solve the puzzle.
senses.exampleCN: 他们花了一小时才解决那道谜题。
senses.why: A puzzle is another kind of knot for the mind.
senses.whyCN: 谜题是另一种打给头脑的结。

senses.title: Crack a case
senses.definition: to discover the truth about something difficult, such as a crime
senses.definitionCN: 查明困难事情的真相，例如案件
senses.example: The detective solved the crime in two days.
senses.why: Loosening a mystery means uncovering what was hidden.
senses.whyCN: 解开谜团，就是揭示被隐藏的东西。

intro.en: Solve comes from a Latin verb meaning to loosen or untie.
intro.cn: solve 来自拉丁语中表示松开、解开的动词。

items.en: Solvere meant to loosen, untie, or dissolve.
items.cn: solvere 意为松开、解开或溶解。

items.en: Solutio named a loosening or an explanation.
items.cn: solutio 指解开或解释。

items.en: English used solve for explaining difficult matters.
items.cn: 英语用 solve 表示解释困难的事情。

items.en: It specialized in answering problems and puzzles.
items.cn: 它专门用于回答问题和谜题。

items.en: It extended to cracking crimes and mysteries.
items.cn: 它的用途扩展到破解案件和谜团。

note.en: Solve is compared with look-alike words and verbs for answering difficulties.
note.cn: 把 solve 与形近词以及表示解决困难的动词作比较。

entries.definition: to end an argument or difficulty

normalIntro.en: To solve is to loosen the knot that a problem has tied.
normalIntro.cn: solve 就是解开问题打下的结。

normal.en: They spent an hour trying to solve the puzzle.
normal.cn: 他们花了一小时才解决那道谜题。

normal.en: The team solved the problem in one meeting.
normal.cn: 团队开了一次会就解决了问题。

normal.en: The detective solved the crime in two days.
Can you solve the equation on the board?
normal.cn: 你能解出黑板上的方程吗？

normal.en: They worked together to solve the mystery.
normal.cn: 他们一起努力解开了谜团。

abstract.en: Every problem is a knot waiting for patient hands.
abstract.cn: 每个问题都是一个等待耐心双手的结。

abstract.en: Solving begins with admitting the knot is real.
abstract.cn: 解决的开端，是承认这个结确实存在。

abstract.en: Some answers are found by pulling, others by letting go.
abstract.cn: 有些答案靠拉紧找到，有些靠松开找到。

examples.en: The team solved the problem in one meeting.

examples.en: The detective solved the crime in two days.

root: 来自拉丁语 solvere（松开、解开），与 solution 同源，核心义「把缠结的东西解开」。

sensesIntro.en: Solve means to deal with a problem, find the answer to a puzzle, or crack a difficult case.
sensesIntro.cn: solve 意为处理问题、找出谜题答案，或破解困难的案件。

core.en: Loosening what was tied up.
core.cn: 把被缠住的东西松开。

branches.en: A team gathers around a difficult question.
branches.cn: 团队围着一个难题想办法。

branches.en: Pieces of a puzzle fall into place.
branches.cn: 拼图一块块落到了正确的位置。

branches.en: A hidden clue is finally uncovered.
branches.cn: 一条隐藏的线索终于被揭开。

branches.en: A practical problem and a crime both hide their answer.
branches.cn: 实际问题与案件都把答案藏了起来。

branches.en: A puzzle and a problem yield to the same patience.
branches.cn: 谜题与难题都在同一种耐心面前让步。

intro.en: Solve has a family of loosening, answering, and dissolving words.
intro.cn: solve 有一组表示松开、解答与溶解的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere meant to loosen or untie.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 solvere 意为松开或解开。

items.example: He solves one puzzle a day.

items.meaning: an answer or a dissolved mixture

这个问题是可以解决的。

items.meaning: to break up into a liquid

latinEntries.example: Solvere is the source of solve.

definition_en: an amount or number that is not stated exactly, a certain one, or about
core_image: 桌上放着几只苹果，看不清到底有几个
scene: 桌上还有一些饼干。There are some biscuits on the table.
sceneCN: 这里 some 是「一些」（第 1 个义项）；句意：桌上还有一些饼干。

senses.title: An unnamed amount
senses.definition: an amount or number that is not stated exactly
senses.definitionCN: 没有确切说明的数量
senses.example: There are some biscuits on the table.
senses.why: Some marks a part of a whole without naming the size.
senses.whyCN: some 标出整体中的一部分，却不说大小。

senses.title: A certain one
senses.definition: used for a person or thing not exactly named
senses.definitionCN: 用于没有确切说出的人或事物
senses.example: Some man called while you were out.
senses.exampleCN: 你出去时有个男人打来电话。
senses.why: The same word covers an unnamed part and an unnamed member.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词既能指未说明的部分，也能指未说明的成员。

senses.title: About, a little
senses.definition: used before numbers to mean about, or before adjectives to mean a little
senses.definitionCN: 用于数字前表示大约，或用于形容词前表示有点
senses.example: Some twenty people came to the talk.
senses.exampleCN: 大约二十个人来听了讲座。
senses.why: An unstated amount becomes an approximate amount.
senses.whyCN: 未说明的数量变成了近似的数量。

intro.en: Some is an old English word for an unspecified part.
intro.cn: some 是英语中表示未指明部分的古老词汇。

items.en: Sum meant some or a certain one.
items.cn: sum 意为一些或某一个。

items.en: The form settled as some.
items.cn: 词形固定为 some。

items.en: It kept the sense of an unstated amount.
items.cn: 它保留了未说明数量的含义。

items.en: It also came to mean a remarkable person or thing.
items.cn: 它也开始指了不起的人或事物。

items.en: It formed compounds such as something and somewhere.
items.cn: 它构成了 something、somewhere 等复合词。

note.en: Some is compared with look-alike words and words for unspecified amounts.
note.cn: 把 some 与形近词以及表示不确定数量的词作比较。

entries.definition: one or some, no matter which
more than two but not many

normalIntro.cn: some 指向一部分或某一个，却不给出数字。

normal.en: There are some biscuits on the table.
Some man called while you were out.
normal.cn: 你出去时有个男人打来电话。

normal.en: Some twenty people came to the talk.
normal.cn: 大约二十个人来听了讲座。

abstract.en: Some is the word for what we know without counting.

abstract.en: An unnamed part is still a real part.
abstract.cn: 没有名字的部分，仍然是真实的部分。

abstract.en: Approximation is how language handles the unmeasured.
abstract.cn: 近似，是语言处理无法测量之事的方式。

examples.en: There are some biscuits on the table.

core.en: A part of something, left uncounted.

branches.en: A few biscuits sit on a plate.
branches.cn: 盘子里放着几块饼干。

branches.en: A voice on the phone belongs to no known name.
branches.cn: 电话里的声音属于一个不知道名字的人。

branches.en: A crowd is counted roughly at a glance.
branches.cn: 一眼扫过去，人群被粗略计数。

branches.en: An unnamed member is a part of a larger group.
branches.cn: 未指名的成员是更大群体的一部分。

intro.en: Some builds a large family of compounds for unknown things and places.

latinIntro.en: Some has no Latin root; it comes from Old English sum.

definition_en: a short piece of music with words, the act of singing, or the sound a bird makes
core_image: 一群人围在篝火旁，一起唱着一首熟悉的歌
scene: 收音机里正放着一首老歌。An old song was playing on the radio.

senses.title: A piece of music
senses.definition: a short piece of music with words for singing
senses.definitionCN: 配有歌词、可供演唱的短小乐曲
senses.example: An old song was playing on the radio.
senses.exampleCN: 收音机里正放着一首老歌。
senses.why: This is the central modern sense of the word.

senses.title: The act of singing

senses.title: Bird sound

senses.why: Birds sing too, and their music borrowed the word.

intro.en: Song comes from the old verb to sing.
intro.cn: song 来自古老的动词 sing（唱）。

items.en: Sang meant a song, from singan, to sing.
items.cn: sang 意为歌曲，来自 singan（唱）。

items.en: The form became song.

items.en: It named both the act and the piece.
items.cn: 它同时指唱歌的行为和所唱的作品。

items.en: It extended to birds and their calls.
items.cn: 它的用法扩展到鸟及其鸣叫。

items.en: It formed many compounds such as songwriter.
items.cn: 它构成了 songwriter 等许多复合词。

note.en: Song is compared with look-alike words and words for music with words.

abstract.en: A song is a feeling that learned to keep time.
abstract.cn: 歌是一种学会了打拍子的感情。

abstract.en: Words alone speak; words in song remain.

abstract.en: Every voice carries a song it did not invent.

examples.en: An old song was playing on the radio.

root: 来自古英语 sang（歌曲），与 singan（唱）同源，核心义「唱出来的东西」。

core.en: Music shaped to carry words.

definition_en: in a short time from now, early, or as soon as
core_image: 站台上的人抬头望着远处，火车灯已经出现在拐弯处
scene: 火车不久就要到了。The train will arrive soon.
sceneCN: 这里 soon 是「不久」（第 1 个义项）；句意：火车不久就要到了。

senses.title: In a short time
senses.definition: in a short time from now
senses.definitionCN: 从现在起很短的时间内
senses.example: The train will arrive soon.
senses.why: The oldest sense is at once or immediately.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是「立刻、马上」。

senses.title: Early
senses.definition: earlier than expected or usual
senses.definitionCN: 比预期或通常更早
senses.example: Do not leave too soon.
senses.why: A short time before a point is an early arrival.
senses.whyCN: 在某个时间点前的一小段时间，就是提前到达。

senses.title: As soon as
senses.definition: immediately when something happens
senses.definitionCN: 某事一发生就立刻
senses.example: Call me as soon as you arrive.
senses.why: The phrase fixes the sense of no delay at all.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语固定了「毫不耽搁」的含义。

intro.en: Soon first meant at once, and later meant in a short time.
intro.cn: soon 最初意为立刻，后来表示在短时间内。

items.en: Sona meant at once or immediately.
items.cn: sona 意为立刻或马上。

items.en: The form became soon.
items.cn: 词形变为 soon。

items.en: It softened to mean in a short time.
items.cn: 它的含义软化为「在短时间内」。

items.en: It also came to mean early.
items.cn: 它也开始表示「早」。

items.en: As soon as became a fixed phrase for no delay.
items.cn: as soon as 成为表示毫不耽搁的固定短语。

note.en: Soon is compared with look-alike words and adverbs of near time.
note.cn: 把 soon 与形近词以及表示临近时间的副词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Soon puts a small distance between now and then.
normalIntro.cn: soon 在现在与那时之间留出一小段距离。

normal.en: The train will arrive soon.
Do not leave too soon.
Call me as soon as you arrive.
Soon after the rain, the sun came out.
Sooner or later, the truth appears.

abstract.en: Soon is the word for a future already on its way.
abstract.cn: soon 是用来指「已经在路上的未来」的词。

abstract.en: Waiting makes soon feel long.
abstract.cn: 等待会让「不久」显得漫长。

abstract.en: What is done soon is often done twice.
abstract.cn: 太快做完的事，常常要再做一遍。

examples.en: The train will arrive soon.
Do not leave too soon.
Soon after the rain, the sun came out.

root: 来自古英语 sona（立刻），核心义从「马上」软化为「不久、很快」。

sensesIntro.en: Soon means in a short time, early, or immediately when something happens.
sensesIntro.cn: soon 意为不久、提早，或某事一发生就立刻。

core.en: A short distance ahead in time.
core.cn: 时间上前方不远处。

branches.en: A train light appears around the bend.
branches.cn: 拐弯处出现了火车的灯光。

branches.en: A guest rises before the meal ends.
branches.cn: 饭还没吃完，客人就起身了。

branches.en: A phone rings the moment a door opens.
branches.cn: 门一开，电话就响了。

branches.en: A short wait and an early start are neighbours.
branches.cn: 短暂的等待与提早出发是邻居。

branches.en: No delay is the shortest kind of soon.
branches.cn: 毫不耽搁，是最短的「不久」。

intro.en: Soon has a small family of comparative and fixed time phrases.

latinIntro.en: Soon has no Latin root; it comes from Old English sona.
latinIntro.cn: soon 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 sona。

items.example: The soonest train leaves at six.

definition_en: feeling regret or sympathy, sad, or in a poor state
core_image: 一个人不小心踩到别人的脚，立刻低头道歉
scene: 我不小心撞到你，连忙道歉。I am sorry for bumping into you.
sceneCN: 这里 sorry 是「抱歉的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：撞到你我很抱歉。

senses.title: Feeling regret
senses.definition: feeling regret about something you have done
senses.definitionCN: 为自己做过的某事感到懊悔
senses.example: I am sorry for bumping into you.
senses.why: This is the everyday sense used in apology.
senses.whyCN: 这是道歉时最常用的日常含义。

senses.title: Feeling sympathy
senses.definition: feeling sad about someone else's trouble
senses.definitionCN: 为他人的不幸而感到难过
senses.example: I am sorry to hear that.
senses.why: The word widened from regret for one's own act to pity for others.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从对自己的行为感到懊悔，扩展到对他人的同情。

senses.title: Poor or pitiful
senses.definition: in a bad or pitiful condition
senses.definitionCN: 处于糟糕或令人怜悯的状态
senses.example: The garden was in a sorry state.
senses.why: A thing left in neglect earns the same word as a person we pity.
senses.whyCN: 被疏忽的事物，和我们同情的人用了同一个词。

intro.en: Sorry grew out of an Old English word for grief.
intro.cn: sorry 由古英语中表示悲痛的一个词发展而来。

items.en: Sarig meant distressed or grieved, from sar, sore.
items.cn: sarig 意为痛苦的、悲伤的，来自 sar（疼痛）。

items.en: The form became sory and kept the sense of grief.
items.cn: 词形变为 sory，保留了悲伤的含义。

items.en: It widened to mean feeling sympathy for others.
items.cn: 它的含义扩展到对他人的同情。

items.en: In polite speech it became the standard word of apology.
items.cn: 在礼貌用语中，它成为标准的道歉词。

items.en: It also came to describe something poor or pitiful.
items.cn: 它也开始形容糟糕或可怜的事物。

note.en: Sorry is compared with look-alike words and words of regret.
note.cn: 把 sorry 与形近词以及表示遗憾的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Sorry is what we say when the heart feels the weight of a mistake.
normalIntro.cn: sorry 是心里感到过错的分量时所说的话。

normal.en: I am sorry for bumping into you.
I am sorry to hear that.
She said sorry and walked away.
The old house was in a sorry state.
He felt sorry for the lost dog.
normal.cn: 他为那只走失的狗感到难过。

abstract.en: Sorry is the shortest bridge back to someone you have hurt.
abstract.cn: sorry 是通向你伤害过的人的最短的桥。

abstract.en: A word of sorry can be lighter than silence.
abstract.cn: 一句道歉，可能比沉默更轻。

abstract.en: What we are sorry for, we have already understood.
abstract.cn: 我们为之抱歉的事，说明我们已有所领悟。

examples.en: I am sorry for bumping into you.
I am sorry to hear that.
The garden was in a sorry state.

dict_mnemonic.text: sorry 与 sore（疼痛）同源，心里「痛」就是抱歉、难过；注意与 sorrow（悲伤）区分词尾，sorry 是形容词，sorry for 为某事抱歉，sorry about 对某事感到抱歉。

root: 来自古英语 sarig（悲伤的），与 sore（疼痛的）同源，核心义从「心里难受」扩展到「抱歉」与「可怜」。

sensesIntro.en: Sorry covers regret for your own act, sympathy for others, and a pitiful condition.
sensesIntro.cn: sorry 涵盖对自己的行为感到抱歉、对他人的同情，以及糟糕可怜的状态。

core.en: A heart that feels regret or pity.
core.cn: 感到懊悔或同情的心。

branches.en: A man bows his head after a mistake.
branches.cn: 一个人犯了错，低下头。

branches.en: A friend holds a hand at a funeral.
branches.cn: 葬礼上，朋友握住对方的手。

branches.en: A neglected garden is full of weeds.
branches.cn: 被疏忽的花园长满杂草。

branches.en: Regret for oneself and pity for others share a face.
branches.cn: 为自己的懊悔与为他人的同情，有着同一副面孔。

branches.en: Pity for people and pity for things use one word.
branches.cn: 对人的怜悯与对物的怜悯，用同一个词。

intro.en: Sorry forms a small family of comparative and related words.
intro.cn: sorry 构成一小族比较级形式和相关词。

latinIntro.en: Sorry has no Latin root; it comes from Old English sarig.

items.example: I am sorry for the delay.
I am sorrier than I can say.
This is the sorriest I have felt.
items.exampleCN: 这是我感到最抱歉的一次。

items.example: There was no sorriness in his voice.
Her face was full of sorrow.

definition_en: something you can hear, to seem a certain way when heard, or healthy and reliable
core_image: 山谷里一声钟响，声波一圈圈传向远处的耳朵
scene: 远处传来奇怪的声音。A strange sound came from the distance.
sceneCN: 这里 sound 是「声音」（第 1 个义项）；句意：远处传来奇怪的声音。

senses.title: What you hear
senses.definition: something that can be heard
senses.definitionCN: 可以被听见的东西
senses.example: A strange sound came from the distance.
senses.why: This is the physical sense at the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最核心的物理含义。

senses.title: To seem when heard
senses.definition: to give a certain impression when heard
senses.definitionCN: 被听见时给人某种印象
senses.example: That plan sounds good to me.
senses.exampleCN: 那个计划在我看来不错。
senses.why: The ear judges, so to sound became to seem.
senses.whyCN: 耳朵会作判断，于是 sound 引申为「显得」。

senses.title: Healthy and reliable
senses.definition: in good condition and able to be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 状况良好、值得信赖的
senses.example: The bridge is structurally sound.
senses.why: This sense came from a different Old English word for healthy.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个表示健康的古英语词。

intro.en: Two old words meet in sound: one for noise, one for health.
intro.cn: 两个古老的词在 sound 中相遇：一个指声音，一个指健康。

items.en: Sonus meant a sound or a noise.
items.cn: sonus 意为声音或响声。

items.en: Son carried the word into French.
items.cn: son 把这个词带入法语。

items.en: Soun named what the ear hears.
items.cn: soun 指耳朵听到的东西。

items.en: Gesund meant healthy and whole.
items.cn: gesund 意为健康的、完好的。

items.en: The two words merged in form, giving noise and health one spelling.
items.cn: 两个词在形式上合并，使「声音」与「健康」共用一种拼写。

items.en: The verb to sound grew from the noun.
items.cn: 动词 sound 由名词发展而来。

note.en: Sound is compared with look-alike words and words for noise.
note.cn: 把 sound 与形近词以及表示声响的词作比较。

entries.definition: a unit of weight or money

normalIntro.en: Sound travels from a source through air to an ear.
normalIntro.cn: sound 从声源穿过空气抵达耳朵。

normal.en: A strange sound came from the distance.
That plan sounds good to me.
normal.cn: 那个计划在我看来不错。

normal.en: The bridge is structurally sound.
They arrived safe and sound.
normal.cn: 他们安然无恙地到达了。

normal.en: The baby is sound asleep.

abstract.en: Sound is air taught to carry meaning.
abstract.cn: 声音是被教会承载意义的空气。

abstract.en: What sounds right is not always what is sound.
abstract.cn: 听起来对的，并不总是可靠的。

abstract.en: A sound mind hears more than noise.
abstract.cn: 健全的心智听到的不只是噪音。

examples.en: A strange sound came from the distance.
That plan sounds good to me.
examples.cn: 那个计划在我看来不错。

examples.en: The bridge is structurally sound.

dict_mnemonic.text: sound 有两个来源：一个来自拉丁语 sonus（声音），一个来自古英语 gesund（健康）；sound like 是「听起来像」，safe and sound 是「安然无恙」，sound advice 是「合理的建议」。

root: 名词「声音」来自拉丁语 sonus，形容词「健全的」来自古英语 gesund，两条来源在现代英语中合流为同一拼写。

sensesIntro.en: Sound names what the ear hears, the impression it gives, and the state of being healthy.
sensesIntro.cn: sound 指耳朵听到的声音、它给人的印象，以及健全可靠的状态。

core.en: A vibration that reaches an ear.
core.cn: 抵达耳朵的振动。

branches.en: A bell shakes the quiet valley.
branches.cn: 钟声震动了安静的山谷。

branches.en: A listener tilts his head and decides.
branches.cn: 听者歪着头作出判断。

branches.en: An engineer tests a beam and nods.
branches.cn: 工程师检测横梁后点了点头。

branches.en: What reaches the ear becomes what the mind believes.
branches.cn: 传到耳朵的东西，变成心里相信的东西。

branches.en: A plan that sounds good may also be sound.
branches.cn: 听起来不错的计划，也可能确实可靠。

intro.en: Sound forms adverbs, nouns, and compounds with -ly, -ness, and -proof.
intro.cn: sound 与 -ly、-ness、-proof 构成副词、名词和复合词。

latinIntro.en: The noun comes from Latin sonus, with relatives sonare and sonitus.
latinIntro.cn: 名词源自拉丁语 sonus，相关词有 sonare 与 sonitus。

items.example: A strange sound came from the distance.
The forest was full of sounds.
items.exampleCN: 森林里充满了各种声音。
他的声音听起来很疲倦。

items.example: They tested the soundness of the wall.
items.exampleCN: 他们检测了墙体的牢固程度。

items.example: The plane broke the sonic barrier.

definition_en: a hot liquid food made by boiling ingredients, a thick broth, or trouble
core_image: 寒冷的冬夜，一碗冒着热气的汤放在桌上
scene: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 soup 是「汤」（第 1 个义项）；句意：妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。

senses.title: Liquid food
senses.definition: a hot liquid food made by boiling vegetables, meat, or fish
senses.definitionCN: 把蔬菜、肉或鱼煮沸制成的热液体食物
senses.example: Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。
senses.why: This is the central everyday sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最核心的日常含义。

senses.title: Thick broth
senses.definition: a thick, often creamy liquid dish
senses.definitionCN: 浓稠、常带奶油的液体菜肴
senses.example: The pumpkin soup was thick and sweet.
senses.why: The same dish thickens into a different texture and name.
senses.whyCN: 同样的菜变浓稠后，质地和名称也随之不同。

senses.title: Trouble
senses.definition: a difficult situation, used in the phrase in the soup
senses.definitionCN: 困难的处境，用于习语 in the soup
senses.example: Losing his job left him in the soup.
senses.why: The idiom pictures a person sunk in a thin, sticky liquid.
senses.whyCN: 这个习语把人想象成陷在一锅稀而黏的汤里。

intro.en: Soup first meant bread soaked in broth, not the broth itself.
intro.cn: soup 最初指泡在肉汤里的面包，而不是汤本身。

items.en: Suppa meant a piece of bread soaked in liquid.
items.cn: suppa 指泡在液体里的一块面包。

items.en: Soupe named the soaked bread and then the broth.
items.cn: soupe 先指泡过的面包，后指肉汤。

items.en: Soupe entered English as a thick broth.
items.cn: soupe 以浓汤之义进入英语。

items.en: Soup became the general word for a liquid dish.
items.cn: soup 成为液体菜肴的统称。

items.en: The phrase in the soup added the sense of trouble.
items.cn: 短语 in the soup 增加了「困境」的含义。

note.en: Soup is compared with look-alike words and other liquid dishes.
note.cn: 把 soup 与形近词以及其他汤类菜肴作比较。

entries.definition: a thin soup made with stock

normalIntro.en: Soup is warmth that can be carried in a bowl.
normalIntro.cn: soup 是能盛在碗里端起的温暖。

normal.en: Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
normal.cn: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。

normal.en: The pumpkin soup was thick and sweet.
Losing his job left him in the soup.
She ate a bowl of soup for lunch.
The volunteers run a soup kitchen downtown.
normal.cn: 志愿者在市中心办了一处施粥所。

abstract.en: Soup is the patient cook's answer to cold weather.
abstract.cn: 汤是耐心的厨子对寒冷天气的回答。

abstract.en: A shared pot of soup makes strangers into neighbours.
abstract.cn: 共饮一锅汤，让陌生人变成邻居。

abstract.en: In the soup means the ground has turned to liquid.
abstract.cn: in the soup 意味着脚下的地变成了流质。

examples.en: Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
examples.cn: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。

examples.en: The pumpkin soup was thick and sweet.
Losing his job left him in the soup.

dict_mnemonic.text: soup 与 soap（肥皂）只差一个字母，注意区分；soupy 是「汤状的」，in the soup 是「陷入困境」，chicken soup 是「鸡汤」。

root: 来自拉丁语 suppa（泡在汤里的面包），经古法语 soupe 进入英语，核心义由「泡面包」转为「汤、羹」。

sensesIntro.en: Soup means a hot liquid dish, a thick broth, or trouble in an idiom.
sensesIntro.cn: soup 指热的液体菜肴、浓羹，以及在习语中表示的困境。

core.en: Ingredients given to water and heat.
core.cn: 交给水和火的食材。

branches.en: Steam rises from a pot on the stove.
branches.cn: 炉上的锅冒出热气。

branches.en: A spoon stands upright in a thick pumpkin soup.
branches.cn: 勺子直立在稠厚的南瓜汤里。

branches.en: A man sinks up to his waist in trouble.
branches.cn: 一个人陷进麻烦，没到腰际。

branches.en: Thin and thick are two textures of one dish.
branches.cn: 稀与稠是同一道菜的两种质地。

branches.en: Something thick and sticky is a good picture of trouble.
branches.cn: 浓稠黏滞之物，正是困境的好写照。

intro.en: Soup forms small adjectives and nouns with -y and -ness.
intro.cn: soup 与 -y、-ness 构成小型形容词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The word goes back to Latin suppa and the verb suppare.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词可追溯到拉丁语 suppa 和动词 suppare。

items.example: Mother is cooking a pot of hot soup in the kitchen.
items.exampleCN: 妈妈在厨房煮了一锅热汤。

items.example: He complained about the soupiness of the sauce.

items.exampleCN: 他开着一辆改装过的车。

items.example: She made a clear chicken broth.
We had beef stew for dinner.
The chef served a lobster bisque.
items.exampleCN: 厨师上了一道龙虾浓汤。

latinEntries.example: Suppa pani in iure madefacta erat.

definition_en: the direction opposite north, the southern part of an area, or toward the south
core_image: 指南针的红针指向下方，那里是温暖的南方
scene: 燕子冬天飞向南方。The swallows fly south in winter.
sceneCN: 这里 south 是「南方」（第 1 个义项）；句意：燕子冬天飞向南方。

senses.title: The direction
senses.definition: the direction that is opposite north
senses.definitionCN: 与北方相反的方向
senses.example: The swallows fly south in winter.
senses.why: This is the compass sense at the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最核心的方位含义。

senses.title: The southern region
senses.definition: the southern part of a country or area
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家或地区的南部
senses.example: He grew up in the south of the country.
senses.exampleCN: 他在这个国家的南方长大。
senses.why: A direction becomes a place when people live there.
senses.whyCN: 当人们在那里生活，方向就变成了地方。

senses.title: Toward the south
senses.definition: in the direction of the south
senses.definitionCN: 朝南方的方向
senses.example: The window faces south.
senses.why: The same word serves as an adverb of direction.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也用作方向副词。

intro.en: South is an old Germanic direction word tied to the sun.
intro.cn: south 是一个古老的日耳曼方向词，与太阳有关。

items.en: Suth meant the south.
items.cn: suth 意为南方。

items.en: The form became south.
items.cn: 词形变为 south。

items.en: It named both a direction and a region.
items.cn: 它既指方向，也指地区。

items.en: It also became an adverb, as in fly south.
items.cn: 它也成为副词，如 fly south。

items.en: Compounds like South Pole fixed its geography.
items.cn: South Pole 等复合词固定了它的地理用法。

note.en: South is compared with look-alike words and direction words.
note.cn: 把 south 与形近词以及表示方向的词作比较。

entries.definition: the opening in the face for eating

normalIntro.en: South is the direction where the sun spends the winter.
normalIntro.cn: south 是太阳过冬的方向。

normal.en: The swallows fly south in winter.
He grew up in the south of the country.
normal.cn: 他在这个国家的南方长大。

normal.en: The window faces south.
The town lies south of the river.
A warm south wind crossed the fields.

abstract.en: South is a promise of warmth written on a compass.
abstract.cn: 南方，是写在指南针上的温暖许诺。

abstract.en: Birds know south before they know the word.
abstract.cn: 鸟在知道这个词之前，就认得南方。

abstract.en: Every direction is only a place seen from far away.
abstract.cn: 每一个方向，都是从远处看见的地方。

examples.en: The swallows fly south in winter.
He grew up in the south of the country.
examples.cn: 他在这个国家的南方长大。

examples.en: The window faces south.

dict_mnemonic.text: south 是南方，southern 是「南方的」，southward 是「向南」；in the south 是「在南方」，south of 是「在……以南」，注意与 mouth（嘴）、youth（青年）区分。

root: 来自古英语 suth（南方），属日耳曼语族，核心义为与北相对的方向，并扩展为南部地区与向南。

sensesIntro.en: South means the direction opposite north, a southern region, or toward the south.
sensesIntro.cn: south 指与北相对的方向、南部地区，或朝南。

core.en: The warm end of the compass needle.
core.cn: 指南针上温暖的那一端。

branches.en: A red needle swings to the bottom of the dial.
branches.cn: 红色指针摆向刻度盘下方。

branches.en: Orange trees grow in the lower country.
branches.cn: 橘树生长在国土的南部。

branches.en: A window is set to catch the sun.
branches.cn: 一扇窗朝向太阳。

branches.en: A direction becomes home when people settle.
branches.cn: 有人定居，方向就成了家。

branches.en: The region and the direction share one name.
branches.cn: 地区与方向共用一个名字。

intro.en: South builds southern, southward, and compass compounds.
intro.cn: south 构成 southern、southward 以及表示方位的复合词。

latinIntro.en: South has no Latin root; it comes from Old English suth.
latinIntro.cn: south 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 suth。

items.example: The swallows fly south in winter.
This southern city is warm in winter.
items.exampleCN: 这座南方城市冬天很温暖。

items.example: The town lies to the southeast.
